DECK.name: Dragons of Justice
DECK.description: Keep your opponent's board clear and finish the job with your high cost dragons.

DECK.name: Deathtrap
DECK.description: Set traps to protect yourself as you control the pace with other spells. End the game with some of your bigger minions or a flurry of damage to your opponent’s hero.

DECK.name: Whispers of Death
DECK.description: Do not fear death, hero; your minions are useful to you both alive and dead. Keep trading your minions for theirs; you will eventually overwhelm them.

DECK.name: Overwhelming Numbers
DECK.description: What is better than three minions?  Seven, of course! Summon an army of smaller minions, and grow them into huge monsters.

DECK.name: Madness and Magic
DECK.description: Cast as many spells as possible: Each one will fuel the reawakening of Yogg-Saron.

DECK.name: Dragonfire
DECK.description: The ancient dragons will crush all opposition, assuming you live long enough to summon them. Nefarian told me to tell you not to embarrass him by dying.

DECK.name: Strike With the Shadows
DECK.description: Take matters into your own hands. Trade in some healing spells for deadly shadow magic and aggressive minions!

DECK.name: The Goons’ Empire
DECK.description: Use every trick in the Grimy Goons' playbook to get one up on your opponent. Finish them off with a huge minion you’ve empowered in your hand.

DECK.name: Murloc Association
DECK.description: One of Gadgetzan’s fishier districts plays home to roving groups of Murlocs. Once you get enough of them together, they can overrun the enemy with a well-timed spell.

DECK.name: The Mean Market
DECK.description: The Goons have helped you procure a few… implements. Power up the minions in your hand before sending them out on a job.

DECK.name: The Lotus’ Golems
DECK.description: Channel the power of the Jade Golems. These minions get stronger for each one you play, so play as many as you can!

DECK.name: Demons of the Kabal
DECK.description: The Kabal traffic in some dark magics. Unleash your darker side and summon some of the most evil demons this side of Azeroth.

DECK.name: Ancient Hordes
DECK.description: Bolster your armies with the innumerable minions of the Old Gods. Swarm the board with smaller minions to overwhelm your opponent.

DECK.name: Gadgetzan Dockside
DECK.description: The pirates are the closest thing to legitimate trade you’ll get in Gadgetzan. Dock your ship and let loose a tide of piracy to rush down your opponent!

DECK.name: Hidden Dragon
DECK.description: Kazakus has always had a soft spot for Dragons. Combine his potions and their fiery might to overwhelm your opponents!

DECK.name: Band of Beasts
DECK.description: Those of you not scared of beasts have clearly never seen one with tons of weapons attached. Suit up your beasts and get ‘em out there!

DECK.name: Kabalist Mixology
DECK.description: The greatest leaders in the Kabal combine their powers into a mixture of fury! Your deck has only one of each card so your leaders can unleash their full power!

DECK.name: Guarding the Shard
DECK.description: Shields up!  You are forging Sulfuras but need more time. Use Taunt minions to protect your hero until you seize the legendary hammer and SWAT SOME INSECTS!

DECK.name: Storm, Earth, and Fire
DECK.description: The elements have come to your aid!  Call upon hordes of elementals, create mighty storms, and crush all who stand in your path…

DECK.name: The Dig
DECK.description: Pirates are searching the ice caverns of Un’goro for hidden treasure. Play the same minion multiple times and unearth the Crystal Core to empower the rest of your scoundrels!

DECK.name: Primordial Blessings
DECK.description: Who really wants small minions? Make them mighty and dinosized!  Cast spells on your small minions to power the crystals and unleash the mighty Galvadon.

DECK.name: Awakenings
DECK.description: Summon forth a glorious host of Deathrattle minions to receive the Light’s ultimate boon.

DECK.name: Might of the Dino King
DECK.description: Dragons and tigers and dinos, oh my! Grow quickly and summon big dinosaurs to draw out Barnabus to stomp your opponent.

DECK.name: Flames of the Phoenix
DECK.description: The chaotic fire elementals hunger for destruction!  Harness their power to melt your opponent’s minions away.

DECK.name: Dinomancer
DECK.description: Set down your bow, and claim the Dinomancer title.  Summon beasts and then supersize them using your new hero power!

DECK.name: Feed the Void
DECK.description: Discard your cards into the volatile Nether Portal.  Tear open the rift and unlock a limitless legion of imps!

DECK.name: The Rock
DECK.description: Control your opponent... with Weapons

DECK.name: Fierce Forest
DECK.description: Fast and fierce, this deck hates weapons!

DECK.name: Spy Stalker
DECK.description: Don't mess with the master of secrets.

DECK.name: Secret Magus
DECK.description: No one can unravel your secrets. Except the Hunter.

DECK.name: Mysterious e-SCALE-ation
DECK.description: Fast. Secrets. Dragons. Good luck!

DECK.name: Unbreakable Inspiration
DECK.description: Slow to start, but inspirational to behold.

DECK.name: The Saint
DECK.description: Fast miracle rogue. Loves weapons and Yogg-Saron.

DECK.name: Totems Hate Secrets
DECK.description: Blast away your opponent's secrets!

DECK.name: Death Becomes Your Foes
DECK.description: You love death and sort of hate weapons.

DECK.name: Merciless Sacrifice
DECK.description: True power comes at a price. Sacrifice your own minions to feed your others and embrace the darkness of the San'layn.

DECK.name: No Pain, No Gain
DECK.description: Your minions are ready and willing to do your bidding and whatever it takes to succeed. Deal damage to your own minions and finish the job as Scourgelord Garrosh, cleaving a path to victory with Shadowmourne.

DECK.name: Pestilence
DECK.description: Corrupt the wilds and disrupt the natural order! Control a swarm of poisonous spiders, scarabs, and big Taunt minions to whittle your opponent down and show them that none can withstand the might of the Scourge.

DECK.name: Shadowreaper's Revenge
DECK.description: The Void shall burn you! Use the power of the Light to accumulate fuel with Lyra the Sunshard. Then unleash the dark power of Shadowreaper Anduin and your army of spell damage minions and spells.

DECK.name: Shields of the Light
DECK.description: Take the fight to the Lich King and go offensive with your Divine Shield minions! Wield the power of the divine to bolster your minions and weapons in the fight against evil.

DECK.name: Jades of Death
DECK.description: Valeera and Aya Blackpaw team up to wreak havoc on their foes. Command your army of Deathrattle and Jade minions to gain early tempo and finish off your opponent with Valeera the Hollow and N'Zoth, the Corruptor.

DECK.name: Remorseless Winter
DECK.description: Control the elements of the frost and stop your opponent cold in their tracks. Freeze the blood in your enemies' veins and use ice to bolster your own minions!

DECK.name: Fire and Ice
DECK.description: Frost Lich Jaina is summoning elementals to do her bidding and is adding a frosty touch. Mix the power of fiery and frosty elementals to burn and freeze your foes.

DECK.name: The Eternal Hunt
DECK.description: Deathstalker Rexxar commands a horde of Deathrattle minions. Send your minions to die and raise them from their graves. Finish off your foe by stitching together beasts and forming grotesque Zombeasts.

DECK.name: Rumble in the Jungle
DECK.description: In this jungle lurks giant beasts and even darker things...

DECK.name: Unleash the Beasts
DECK.description: Release a stampede of beasts while hunting for the Marsh Queen!

DECK.name: Elemental Secrets
DECK.description: Guard your secrets and unleash elemental fury!

DECK.name: Dark Light
DECK.description: Bend the Light to your will, while you unleash the Apocalypse!

DECK.name: The Rock
DECK.description: Bash your opponent with weapons

DECK.name: Unbreakable Inspiration
DECK.description: Slow to start, but inspirational to behold.

DECK.name: The Acolyte
DECK.description: Fast miracle rogue who worships Yogg-Saron.

DECK.name: Totems Hate Secrets
DECK.description: Blast away your opponent's secrets!

DECK.name: Death Becomes Your Foes
DECK.description: Summon monstrous demons and burn away the enemy's weapons

DECK.name: Call to Arms
DECK.description: Your Silver Hand Recruits are ready for action! Call upon the power of your eager recruits. They've been training heavily and are ready to prove their worth and Level Up! on the battlefield.

DECK.name: Out of the Woods
DECK.description: Recruit the mighty creatures of the dungeon to your cause! Clone your party and overwhelm your foes with powerful Deathrattle effects.

DECK.name: I Hunt Alone
DECK.description: Even though your deck has no minions, you'll never truly be alone. Set deadly traps and summon animal allies until you're ready to finish off your foes with Rhok'delar!

DECK.name: Spells are fun, SO FUN!
DECK.description: Mage is all about big, flashy spells. But what kind of minions do you want in a deck like that? Ones that give you MORE spells! Once you've had your fill of slinging magic, use Dragoncaller Alanna to summon the fury of the mighty Red Dragonflight!

DECK.name: Dragon's Call
DECK.description: Harness the power of the Dragon Soul to strike fear into your opponent’s heart. Unleash the twilight dragons upon your foes, leaving you and your hoard of loot alone.

DECK.name: Shrouded in Secrecy
DECK.description: Sonya Shadowdancer has signed a secret pact with the Fal'dorei. Help your new allies swarm the battlefield again and again until your enemy is no more.

DECK.name: Totemic Call
DECK.description: Winds, obey my command! Bless your simple totems with enchantments to keep them alive. Once the ritual is complete, summon Al'Akir the Windlord to crush your foes!

DECK.name: The Dark Pact
DECK.description: Bloodreaver Gul'dan has acquired a weapon of insurmountable power and entered into a dark pact to wield it. Do you dare unlock the power of the Skull of the Man'ari and the demons that serve it?

DECK.name: Armor Up!
DECK.description: Outlast your opponents in this war of attrition. Why just wear armor when you can fight with it?! Keep your armor high and finish the game with an army of Mithril Golems.

DECK.name: Victory at Hand
DECK.description: Take advantage of card advantage with effects that become more powerful with lots of cards in hand. Overwhelm enemies with a constant stream of minions!

DECK.name: Dragons of the Swamp
DECK.description: The denizens of the marsh love to be in the presence of death. Join their hunt and your opponents will fall prey to the monsters of the Witchwood!

DECK.name: Book of Specters
DECK.description: The Book of Specters contains tales of many monsters. None are more terrifying than the heartless Elementals, ready to devour any who cross their path.

DECK.name: Greymane's Alliance
DECK.description: Genn Greymane joins forces with the Silver Hand, using only even-Cost cards to purge Gilneas of the Witchwood's encroaching evils.

DECK.name: Moonlight Vigil
DECK.description: Baku's presence infuses your Hero Power with moonlight in this deck of only odd-Cost cards. Keep your minions healthy, then empower them!

DECK.name: Ghostly Echoes
DECK.description: The Witchwood is no place to travel alone... echoes of past tragedies linger in the air, threatening to drive mad any who overstay their welcome.

DECK.name: Witchwood Awoken
DECK.description: The Witchwood stirs, awoken by the magics of Hagatha herself! Build up powerful Battlecry effects, then repeat them with the horrifying Shudderwock.

DECK.name: Witch's Bargain
DECK.description: Power may come at a price, but seeing your enemies cower before you is worth any cost. Unleash the very darkness of the Witchwood!

DECK.name: Rush In!
DECK.description: Your minions are looking for a fight, and they know how to win. Punish your opponent's every move and smash your way to an overwhelming victory!

DECK.name: The Gilneas Armory
DECK.description: Tank Up with this deck of all odd-Cost cards, Taunt your opponents as they run out of resources, then blast them with the power of Ragnaros himself!

DECK.name: The Boomsday Project
DECK.description: Dr. Boom's Mech factory is developing DEADLY technology. (Dr. Boom's Guarantee: Probably more deadly for your opponent!)

DECK.name: Demonology Lab
DECK.description: The scientific field of study favored by Warlocks is all about experimenting on Demons and ghosts. Don't worry, they won't mind... probably.

DECK.name: The Omega Project
DECK.description: The clock is ticking. Reach 10 Mana Crystals to unlock the power of the Omega Project and bring doom to any who stand in your way!

DECK.name: Stolen Research
DECK.description: "Borrow" ideas from your opponent by generating cards from their class, then use them for profit. Who knew being a scientist was so easy?!

DECK.name: The Necrium Trials
DECK.description: Myra Rotspring is studying the effects of Necrium and has nicknamed it "Artificial Death." Test subjects say it feels just like the real thing!

DECK.name: Kangor's Endless Army
DECK.description: Build a custom Mech army! Magnetic Mechs combine to create all new ways to smash your opponent.

DECK.name: Witchwood Awoken
DECK.description: The Witchwood stirs, awoken by the magics of Hagatha herself! Your powerful spells and minions assure you maintain complete control of the battlefield.

DECK.name: The Storm Bringer
DECK.description: The Netherstorm is home to fearsome Elementals. Harness their power and bring destruction to your foes at lightning speed!

DECK.name: Flark's Fireworks
DECK.description: Have a bomb? Want to attach another bomb, strap on some rockets, then watch everything explode? Then Boommaster Flark has a deck for you!

DECK.name: Trees Are Friends
DECK.description: Teach the trees to fight back! Cultivate an army of Treants that will tear asunder any who would dare loot and plunder.

DECK.name: Quest For Immortality
DECK.description: Zerek, Master Cloner will conduct any experiment necessary to achieve immortality. Copy Deathrattle minions and discover the secret for yourself!

DECK.name: Awesome Augmentation
DECK.description: Priest Scientists are hard at work discovering how to hit someone really, really hard. Buff up a minion and share your findings - with your opponent!

DECK.name: Shooting Stars
DECK.description: Mages have learned how to wield the very power of the stars. Combine Spell Damage with devastating effects to erase your enemies from existence!

DECK.name: Feral Frenzy
DECK.description: Take matters into your own hands! Improve your hero's Attack to enable Gonk's Raptors to take over the battle.

DECK.name: Animal Instincts
DECK.description: Boost the power of your beasts with the Spirit of the Lynx. Swarm the board early, then get even more beasts with the help of Halazzi!

DECK.name: Power of the Dragonhawk
DECK.description: The Dragonhawks LOVE fire! Upgrade your hero power for even MORE FIRE! Set enough things on fire and you might even summon the Firelord himself...

DECK.name: Shirvallah's Chosen
DECK.description: Shirvallah's Tigers say they're the strongest fighters in Stranglethorn. Enhance your minions with powerful spells to test their might.

DECK.name: Surrender to Madness
DECK.description: Bwonsamdi's Zombies don't stay dead for long. Shuffle your fallen minions into your deck with Spirit of the Dead, then power them up with Surrender to Madness!

DECK.name: Cursed Crew
DECK.description: The Sharkfin Crew has bribed Genn Greymane to join their cause. Raid the board with your pirates and blow your opponent out of the water with Cannon Barrage.

DECK.name: Big Bad Voodoo
DECK.description: Da Frogs are big into voodoo, 'mon. Embrace your darker side and evolve your minions for powerful and unpredictable results!

DECK.name: Reckless Ritual
DECK.description: The trolls will sacrifice just about anything to win. Manipulate your discard effects to unlock extra power and take over the game!

DECK.name: Wings of War
DECK.description: War Master Voone is building an army of dragons to take the Rumble by storm. Turn your foes to ashes with their powerful battlecry effects!

DECK.name: Hir'eek's Offering
DECK.description: Swarm the board with sacrificial minions to offer to the Spirit of the Bat. End the game by unleashing the mad god Hir'eek upon your opponent!

DECK.description: Summon powerful minions with the help of Khadgar and Kalecgos. Keep your opponent's minions at bay with freeze effects and devastating board clears!

DECK.description: Summon and heal huge Taunt minions to take over the game. If they fall, resurrect them with the help of Catrina Muerte!
